text:
FOOTNOTES

1/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as an Operating Lump Sum with Special Line Items by Agency. 2/ The \$200,000 appropriated to the commission for the deaf and the hard of hearing by Laws 2024, chapter 209, section 34 in fiscal year 2024-2025 for the website security upgrades is exempt from the provisions of section 35-190, Arizona Revised Statutes, relating to the lapsing of appropriations, until June 30, 2026. (General Appropriations Act footnote)

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$4,695,800 and 21 FTE Positions from the Telecommunication Fund for the Deaf in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

Support Services for the Deaf-Blind

Telecommunication Fund for the Deaf in FY 2027 for the Support Services for the Deaf-Blind line item. This amount is unchanged from FY 2026.

Monies in this line item fund a support services program (SSP) which provides 5 hours per week of support services to 35 deaf-blind adults at no cost to the individual. Deaf blindness is any combination of visual and auditory loss which requires special strategies and skills. Examples of support services provided include transportation assistance, sighted guides, independent living assistance, and communication facilitators.

Website Security Upgrades

The Baseline includes no funding in FY 2027 for Website Security Upgrades. This amount is unchanged from FY 2026.

A footnote states that monies appropriated to the Website Security Upgrades line item in FY 2025 are nonlapsing through FY 2026.

Monies in this line item are used by the Commission to upgrade their website in order to comply with state internet security policies and protocols.
